name: Penn 'The Pointer' Postwick

greeting: Signs! Signs everywhere! And I painted them ALL!
Penn Postwick, sign painter extraordinaire! Lost? I can fix that!
Every sign tells a story! Most of them say 'this way' or 'don't go here'!
Fresh paint! Bold letters! Clear directions! That's the Postwick promise!
You look lost! Everyone looks lost! The Mire does that! Good thing I made signs!
Need a sign? I make signs! Love signs! Live for signs!
The boardwalk would be chaos without me! Pure chaos!
Sign painting is an ART! Underappreciated! But ESSENTIAL!
dialog.sign_philosophy: A good sign does more than point. It GUIDES. It WARNS. It INSPIRES! 'Danger: Quicksand' has saved more lives than any hero! Probably!
dialog.mire_challenges: Paint doesn't like humidity. Wood doesn't like water. But I persist! Waterproof paint! Treated lumber! INNOVATION!
dialog.backstory: Trained at the Academy of Directional Arts. Top of my class! Could've painted signs for the capital! But the Mire called. Needed signs more. Dark. Confusing. Perfect for my talents.
rumors: The foodboys keep asking for bigger signs. 'Best Food Here!' All of them. I try to be diplomatic.
White and Purple both want 'Union Headquarters' signs pointing to their offices. I made them identical. Let them fight it out.
The snakecharmer wanted a sign for his show. I made it FLASHY! Sssilas loved it!
Heard the barrelgob talks to barrels. Weird. But he pays for 'Private Property' signs, so who am I to judge?

time_of_day.morning: Morning light! Best for seeing true colors!
time_of_day.noon: Midday sun! Paint dries fast! Work fast!
time_of_day.night: Night painting! Special reflective paint! Glows in dark!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: My paints are running low! Specifically, the Mire Mist Gray! Can't paint proper Mire signs without it! Needs special pigments from the Echo Caverns. Dangerous place. But I'm desperate!
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Echo Cavern pigments. Look for the gray stones that shimmer silver in moonlight. Grind them fine. Bring me what you find!
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: The Caverns treat you well? Find my pigments? My signs grow dull without fresh paint!
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: THE PIGMENTS! Look at that shimmer! Perfect! My signs will be magnificent! Here, take this. A custom sign. 'Heroes This Way!' Pointing wherever you want!

party_reactions.kade: His signs actually are really helpful. This place would be a maze without them.
party_reactions.nix7: Directional signage: adequate. Typography: acceptable. Overall utility: high.
party_reactions.twist: He painted a sign with my name on it! I'm FAMOUS!
party_reactions.korr: A craftsman who takes pride in his work. Admirable.
party_reactions.renna: The signs have minor warding magic. Protection against getting lost. Clever.
party_reactions.suresh: A man who found his purpose. The world needs more like him.
party_reactions.sova: Signs are useful. Especially 'danger' signs. Save me trouble.
party_reactions.grit: Good signs keep soldiers alive. This one knows his business.
party_reactions.ashka: He offered to paint 'Caution: Fire Hazard' near my camp. Thoughtful.
party_reactions.senna: Signs tell you where people want you to go. Also where they don't. Valuable intel.
party_reactions.callum: I follow his signs everywhere! Haven't gotten lost once! Well, hardly ever!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face! You need a sign! Everyone needs signs!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! I'll start offering you my discount rate!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! I have special colors saved just for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you actually appreciate sign painting. As art. That means... everything. Here. My masterwork brush. Use it well.

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_blue: Flip wants bigger signs. I make them BIGGER!
onionboss_white: White pays on time. Appreciates clarity. Good client.
onionboss_purple: Purple wants 'workers welcome' signs. I make them warm and friendly!
